headings.usage: H1-H4 headings for clear, bold impact
headings.instruction: Use tightly tracked headings (tracking-tighter). Avoid generic sans.

body.instruction: Standard body font. Maintain high legibility.

monospace.usage: Eyebrows, numbers, leverage scores, metrics, code snippets
monospace.instruction: Crucial for the 'CONCEPTOR' tactical identity. Use for all numeric outputs, form labels, and data points.

colors.instruction: Maintain a 'Tactical Minimalism' or 'Swiss Brutalist' dark mode look. 95% monochrome, 5% high contrast red.

visual enhancers.borders: 1px solid #262626. Sharp corners (rounded-none) or very subtle (rounded-sm/max 4px).
visual enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use border definition instead of box-shadow in dark mode. For elevated states, use intense but small red glow shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(227,51,51,0.2)].
visual enhancers.textures: Use background grain or technical grid lines (SVG pattern) to make it feel like a command center.
visual enhancers.hover_states: Red border highlights, text turns pure white, subtle -translate-y-[1px].

component name: Shadcn/UI components (heavily customized for Brutal/Tactical look)

grids.dashboard: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12) for the leverage score and BATNA output.
grids.bento: Asymmetric Bento-style layout for educational sections and results dashboard.
grids.rules: Every pixel must be utilized in dashboard mode. Use h-full on children to ensure they stretch.

layouts.spacing: Generous internal padding (p-6, p-8) on cards to create breathing room against sharp borders. Gap-4 to gap-8 for bento.
layouts.navigation: Pill-style or tab-style top navigation (Leverage Score / 4 Pilar / BATNA Builder / Script Generator / Pre-Nego). Active state gets a red bottom border or red background.

motion.transitions: Use specific properties for transitions (e.g. transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease).
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements, subtle scale or border color changes.
motion.data_reveal: Staggered entrance animations for leverage score and pillar breakdowns.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure pure white text on black background for APCA compliance. Interactive elements must have 3:1 minimum against adjacent colors.
accessibility.focus: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-500 focus:outline-none for all interactive elements.

media.images: Not primarily an image-heavy site. Rely on typography, grid lines, and monochromatic data visualization.
media.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (sharp/regular) or Lucide Icons (stroke-width: 1.5).

3d libraries.recommendation: Not strictly necessary, but Recharts should be used for data visualization (radar charts for 4 pillars, bar charts for leverage).

background_texture.description: Optional subtle noise/grain texture overlaid on the dark background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a React (vite) UI with heavily customized Tailwind styles focusing on the 'CONCEPTOR' brand (Black background, Red accents, Monospace eyebrows).
Ensure all copy is in Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia).
Create a context picker at the start (salary raise, job offer, business deal, custom).
Build a step-by-step form for P.A.C.T. (Performance, Achievement, Comparison, Timing) metrics and BATNA builder.
Implement a dashboard showing Leverage Score, Pillar breakdown, Anchor number, Target, Walk-away, and ZOPA.
Add a mock AI script streaming view for the negotiation script.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals; always use #121212 or #1a1a1a.
Use JetBrains Mono for all data/metrics/scores to emphasize the technical nature.
Do not round corners excessively; stick to `rounded-none` or `rounded-sm` (max 4px).
Implement the UI in .js files as it's a standard React project.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep surfaces mostly flat (brutalist).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Left-align text for a clinical, tactical feel.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Use sonner for toasts (located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx or .tsx).
